evidence.why: Entry writes, selector branch, and physics argument mapping.
Write-only distance output and final XY velocity calculation.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline description of x18 as a consumed movement accumulator; the helper writes it without reading its previous value. Canonical callee bodies independently establish the outgoing numeric states.
facts.value: The two entries initialize mv.ch.unk0.xC from alternative Crazy Hand attribute pairs for numeric states 0x16D and 0x16E. Phys passes xC as a destination, &mv.ch.unk0.x18 as a write-only zero-or-distance output, da->x14 as a strict arrival threshold, and da->x10 as a movement scale. The destination helper overwrites the preceding animation-derived XY self-velocity without writing Z velocity. Anim reads x20 only after animation exhaustion: one selects ftCh_Init_801592D4, whose definition enters 0x16F beside BackAirplane1 callbacks; every other value selects ftCh_Init_80158F34, whose definition enters 0x172 beside BackPunch callbacks.
